verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: one-line headline with a readable subhead, and the CTA sits right-aligned. Its flaws are the tiny SOLSTICE wordmark jammed beside the headline, a cropped phone, and badge pills nearly as heavy as the CTA. B squeezes the headline onto two lines and leaves the subhead illegibly small, crammed at the bottom edge. Its badges are as big as the CTA, SUMMER ONLY floats off on its own with empty space beneath, and there is a dead gap between the phone and the text.
